sections.title: Vendored native components
entries: llama.cpp (vendored snapshot via llama-cpp-2 0.1.156) — MIT — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp. Used for on-device GGUF inference.

sections.title: Flutter / Dart components
entries: Flutter engine and framework (3.47.4 stable) — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/flutter/flutter. Distributed as the platform runtime, not modified by Harbor.
flutter_localizations and Dart 'packages' SDK libraries used by the app — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/flutter/flutter.
package:ffi and package:lints (Dart packages locked by pubspec.lock) — Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause respectively — https://pub.dev.

sections.title: Bundled model packages (downloaded on demand, not shipped in the binary)
entries: stories260K (tinyllamas GGUF) — Apache-2.0 — acquired as tinyllamas/stories260K.gguf per the signed catalog (fixtures/catalog/signed_catalog.json).

sections.title: Fonts and design assets
entries: Platform system fonts only; Harbor does not bundle third-party font binaries. Harbor Current 2 design tokens are original to the project.
